summary: Verified new parent 'Completion Summary' PDF end-to-end: backend endpoint GET /api/court-path/completion-summary.pdf and the court-complete-card on the Court Ordered page. All backend and frontend acceptance criteria passed.

PDF closing line and footer disclaimer ('not a legal document or proof of compliance') are both present; no answer/score tokens observed in the rendered PDF text.
Frontend CourtCompleteCard uses only count + API; no answer data touched. 409 is handled with the right unlock message in toast.
test_credentials: ccalert@test.com / TestPass123! (card SHOULD show, API 200); ccparent@test.com / TestPass123! (card must NOT show, API 409); fresh registered parent returns 409 as expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Completion Summary feature covered. For reaching the Court page UI, the preview URL requires: 1) click [data-testid=login-show-email-toggle] to reveal email/password inputs; 2) after /dashboard loads, dismiss any legal-ack modal BEFORE clicking [data-testid=door-court] (clicking door first then dismissing legal-ack flips the view back to the door landing). After that, [data-testid=court-menu] and [data-testid=court-complete-card] appear in-view (not route change). pdftotext available at /usr/bin/pdftotext for PDF assertions. All assertions on the ccalert PDF confirmed: 'Completion Summary' header, headline 'You've finished what your professional asked for.', 'Case CC-AKDYZ5 · Professional: Sam Parent', 'Casey Alert · 1 of 1 done', 'Foundation Statement ... Done · Oct 11, 2026', closing 'does not include any of your answers', footer disclaimer 'not a legal document or proof of compliance'. Toast 'Your summary is downloading.' observed. rca of the issue: No issues found; feature works per spec.
